anime_multiverse.configuration.djinn.tin: The Lesser Summon is drawn as a real tiny Djinn, a small 3D figure of your Djinn at your shoulder. Off brings back the old translucent bust.
The most Tiny Djinn drawn in one frame; the nearest ones are kept. 0 draws none.
Float the Djinn's name over its figure when you are within 16 blocks.
A thin bar under the name that shows the seconds the Lesser Summon has left.
Draw the figure's head in the circle of the Djinn panel during a Lesser Summon, instead of the silhouette.
